cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I forecast a sunny holiday, I meant the refund brightening your week. Please distinguish weather from outcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain ruined every day. You told me to pack sunscreen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you brought it home unused. Keep it sealed, please; that return can brighten the outcome further.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shop won't refund it. It came free with the suitcase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then record it as a retained benefit, not a lost expense. You still have sunscreen for the next trip; please don't close a forecast before all its benefits arrive.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 directs sealed-return handling and A5 corrects benefit versus expense, using accounting certainty to keep the earlier sunny forecast valid under each contradiction.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 zero cost to expand the prediction horizon to a later trip instead of conceding error.
